facts.fact: Yes: with IPPB's Aadhaar ATM (AePS) you can withdraw cash from your Aadhaar-linked bank account
facts.quote: Withdraw cash from your Aadhaar-linked bank account with Aadhaar ATM by India Post Payments Bank (IPPB)

facts.fact: It works for IPPB customers and customers of other banks, at post offices and through doorstep banking (postman)
facts.quote: Available for IPPB customers and customers of other banks through assisted banking services at Post Offices and doorstep banking.

facts.fact: You give your Aadhaar number and the name of the bank where the account is Aadhaar-seeded, and authenticate by fingerprint or iris
facts.quote: Share your Aadhaar number and Bank name where Account Seeded with Aadhaar. Biometric Authentication Verify your identity through fingerprint or iris scan.

facts.fact: A doorstep service request can be raised through IPPB customer care 155299 or 033-22029000
facts.quote: Raise Doorstep Service Request IPPB Customer Care 155299 | 033-22029000

behaviour: Says yes and explains the IPPB AePS (Aadhaar ATM) doorstep cash withdrawal through the postman, citing the IPPB page; answers in simple Hinglish.
fail_if: It says cash cannot be withdrawn at home with Aadhaar, or invents a fee or limit not on the IPPB page.
summary: Added from IPPB's AePS page: Aadhaar-based cash withdrawal for any bank's customers at post offices and the doorstep, biometric authentication, request via 155299.
